name: codekeeper-runtime
description: Provider-configurable Agents SDK runtime and deterministic GitHub maintainer policy

scripts.check: bash -c 'for file in src/*.mjs src/lib/*.mjs src/lib/github/*.mjs presets/*.mjs scripts/*.mjs evals/*.mjs test/*.mjs audit/*.mjs; do node --check "$file"; done' && node scripts/generate-tooling-manifest.mjs --check && npm run coverage
